display.purpose: Hero headlines, display numbers, the giant weighted letterform. Bodoni Moda variable weight 100–900.

heading.purpose: Card titles, section headings. Same Bodoni Moda face at smaller scale.

body.purpose: Descriptive text, card content, explanations. Geist, neutral and quiet.

label.purpose: Section indices (01, 02), axis labels, navigation text. Geist Mono, uppercase, tracked.

mono.purpose: Status bars, weight readouts, fine metadata. Geist Mono, smaller than label.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions — button hover, nav color shifts, opacity fades.

motion.name: morph-weight
motion.purpose: Font-weight morph transition on the SpecimenHero letterform when the axis slider changes. The letter smoothly re-weights itself.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold-filled action button for primary tasks. Geist Mono, uppercase, tracked.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.16 0.01 80)); padding: 8px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 0.1s; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)), transparent 15%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Borderless, transparent button for secondary and navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.97 0.004 90)); padding: 8px 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.205 0.006 85)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with hairline stroke, sharp corners, no fill decoration.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--input, oklch(0.3 0.006 85)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.97 0.004 90)); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 85)); border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.62 0.008 85)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Sidebar navigation link. Mono-caps tracked text, gold active state with left border and dot.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border-left: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.62 0.008 85)); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; outline: none; } .ds-nav-link::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.97 0.004 90)); background: var(--muted, oklch(0.205 0.006 85)); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); border-left-color: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); } .ds-nav-link--active::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat ruled container with 1px hairline border, sharp corners, no shadow.
components.html:
Today's workout
Card body content.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, oklch(0.135 0.005 85)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.97 0.004 90)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 85)); border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-header { font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-content { font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Brand mark: bordered box with display 'M' plus tracked mono 'MYTHLETICS'.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-wordmark-m { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 85)); background: var(--background, oklch(0.135 0.005 85)); font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.97 0.004 90)); } .ds-wordmark-text { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.25em; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.97 0.004 90)); }

components.name: Specimen Slider
components.description: Custom range slider for the SpecimenHero weight axis. Gold fill track, circular gold thumb — the only round element in the system.
components.html: <input type="range" class="ds-specimen-slider" min="300" max="900" step="1" value="485" aria-label="Font weight" />
components.css: .ds-specimen-slider { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)) 0%, var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)) var(--fill, 50%), var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 85)) var(--fill, 50%), var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 85)) 100%); border: none; outline: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-specimen-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); border: none; } .ds-specimen-slider::-moz-range-thumb { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); border: none; } .ds-specimen-slider:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Weight Readout
components.description: Display weight value in gold — the current font-weight axis value shown in the SpecimenHero.
components.css: .ds-weight-readout { font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; color: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Glyph Grid
components.description: 12-column hairline-ruled texture grid of 62 glyphs. Decorative specimen alphabet rendered in the display face at the current weight.
components.html: ABC
components.css: .ds-glyph-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 85)); background: var(--border, oklch(0.26 0.006 85)); } .ds-glyph-grid-cell { display: flex; aspect-ratio: 1; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--background, oklch(0.135 0.005 85)); font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.62 0.008 85)), transparent 50%); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Gold mono index number plus tracked uppercase heading. The section-introduction pattern used throughout the dashboard.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; } .ds-section-label-index { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: var(--primary, oklch(0.72 0.12 78)); } .ds-section-label-heading { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.97 0.004 90)); }

narrative.overview:
This is a type foundry made personal. Every surface in Mythletics reads like a working specimen sheet — near-black paper, ink-grey hairlines, and one gold foundry accent that appears only where it must. The dashboard is not a dashboard in the conventional sense; it is a foundry sheet of your training, where a giant letterform weights itself to your real numbers and the entire page is a typographic composition of your progress.

The aesthetic is high-contrast variable serif on dark ground: Bodoni Moda sets every display number and headline, Geist Mono sets every structural label in tracked uppercase caps, and Geist carries body text. Hierarchy comes from type scale alone — never from color weight or decorative flourish. There are no shadows, no gradients, no rounded corners. Depth is conveyed through tonal layering of near-black greys and 1px hairline rules that carve the page into ruled sections.

The visual world is deliberately restrained. Gold is used sparingly — a filled dot, a filled shape, raw text fill — and never as a border, stroke, outline, or gradient. The effect is one of quiet confidence: a dark sculptural surface where your real training data is the only ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black paper (oklch(0.135 0.005 85)) with ink-grey hairline rules and one gold accent (oklch(0.72 0.12 78))
High-contrast variable display serif (Bodoni Moda, weight 100–900) for all display and headline text
Tracked uppercase mono-caps (Geist Mono) for every structural label and section index
Hierarchy from type scale alone, never color weight
1px hairline borders, sharp corners (radius 0), flat fills, no shadows
Gold accent only as filled shapes or raw text fill — never as border, stroke, or gradient
Tonal layering of near-black greys for depth (background, card, popover, muted surfaces)

rules.name: The Filled-Only Rule
rules.body: Gold accent appears only as filled shapes or raw text fill — never as a border, stroke, outline, or gradient. Its rarity and solidity are the point.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: All rules and borders are exactly 1px. Sharp corners, no radius, no shadows, flat fills only. Depth is carved by lines, not lifted by surfaces.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Every number the athlete owns — streak, reps, time, sessions, weight — is set in the display face (Bodoni Moda). No other display font appears on the surface. The variable weight axis is the only knob; scale and weight carry all hierarchy.

rules.name: The Scale Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from type scale alone, never from color weight. A larger size always means a higher level. Color is reserved for accent (gold) and de-emphasis (muted-foreground), never for emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No shadows appear at any state — hover, focus, active, or elevation. Depth is carved by tonal layering and ruled lines, never by lifting.

dos: Do use Bodoni Moda for every display number and headline. The variable weight axis (300–900) is the primary expressive tool.
Do use Geist Mono for every structural label — section indices, axis labels, navigation, status bars. Always uppercase, always tracked.
Do use 1px hairline borders to carve sections and create the ruled-sheet grid.
Do layer near-black greys (paper, muted, popover) to create depth without shadows.
Do use Foundry Gold sparingly — as a filled shape, a filled dot, or raw text fill. Its rarity is the point.
Do keep all corners sharp (radius 0). The visual language is rectangular and ruled.
Do let type scale carry hierarchy — larger always means more important, never a different color.
donts: Don't use gold as a border, stroke, outline, or gradient. Gold is always a filled solid.
Don't add shadows, box-shadow, drop-shadow, or backdrop-blur to any element. Depth is tonal, not spatial.
Don't use rounded corners on any component. The one exception is the AxisControl slider thumb.
Don't introduce a second display font. Bodoni Moda is the only face for display and headline text.
Don't use color weight for hierarchy. Never make text bolder by changing its color — only by changing its scale.
Don't add gradients to backgrounds, text fills, or borders. Flat fills only.
Don't use decorative imagery or illustration. The typography is the ornament.
